en: Colorized vintage postcard view of a large forest café/guesthouse in a wooded, hilly landscape. The central building is an ornate villa with half‑timbered elements, red roofs, and a prominent onion‑shaped tower. A path and small bridge lead up from a road in the foreground, with railings and a signpost along the way. Tall conifer trees surround the building, and distant hills are visible under a blue sky with scattered clouds. Printed captions at the top identify the location as Karlsbad and the establishment as Wald‑Café St. Hubertus; an arched sign in front of the building repeats the café name.
